purpose: Complementary SQL and Cypher resources for multi-step cross-source queries and bridge resolution.

source_design_validity.business_split: SQL keeps singer profile attributes; Cypher keeps concert participation and venue relationships.
source_design_validity.valid_case_pattern: Identify a singer by profile attributes in SQL, then follow that singer to concerts or stadiums in the graph; or identify a singer through concert relationships in the graph, then retrieve singer profile attributes from SQL.
source_design_validity.anti_pattern: Do not bridge a singer to unrelated venue facts unless the question follows a concert participation path.

source_design_validity.business_split: SQL keeps student profile attributes; Cypher keeps friendship and like relationships.
source_design_validity.valid_case_pattern: Identify students by profile attributes in SQL, then inspect their social relationships in the graph; or identify a student through social relationships in the graph, then retrieve roster attributes from SQL.
source_design_validity.anti_pattern: Do not use arbitrary student attributes unless they are meaningful for a school or social-network task.

source_design_validity.business_split: SQL keeps player profile and ranking history; Cypher keeps match participation and outcomes.
source_design_validity.valid_case_pattern: Identify a player by ranking or profile data in SQL, then inspect match outcomes in the graph; or identify a player through match relationships in the graph, then retrieve profile or ranking attributes from SQL.
source_design_validity.anti_pattern: Do not use graph-duplicated player display fields as the only reason to cross sources.

source_design_validity.business_split: Cypher keeps Star Wars entity relationships; SQL keeps detailed entity attributes.
source_design_validity.valid_case_pattern: Use graph relationships to identify an entity, then look up detailed attributes in SQL.
source_design_validity.anti_pattern: Do not bridge to an unrelated SQL entity type just because its ID is available.

notes: Bridge mappings use stable original identifiers and are exact_unique by construction.
Bridge mappings are a technical inventory, not an automatic list of valid benchmark cases.
Valid cases must pass scenario continuity checks in data/paired_benchmark/case_schema_v1.json.
